records.newText: Skills don't level up by themselves: you spend points, and each skill level also needs a character level. Skill level L opens at the level you learned the skill + 3 × (L − 2). Earth's Retribution, learned at Lv 1, reaches skill level 5 at Lv 10. Each level costs 1 point (levels 2–4), 2 points (5–7) or 4 points (8–10).
records.note: The Assassin guide's claim C02, with the Cleric's Earth's Retribution as the example (learned at Lv 1, Metabot and the owner's Cleric skill window). Three Cleric passives (Earth's Grace, Survival Willpower, Radiant Benediction) have a flat gate instead: every level opens when the skill is learned.

records.note: docs/research/2026-10-cleric-pack.md §4. Each pick has two or more sources; Condemnation and Light of Regeneration are the majority with one dissent each. Earth's Retribution and Judgment Thunder are split two against two, so the guide picks neither. Condemnation's Lv 12 cooldown reset (:4) is agreed by every source and is the guide's key moment: skill Lv 10 from points plus the two Condemnation board nodes the plan buys (Nezekan, Zikel) reach effective Lv 12 inside the Lv 45 plan (skill Lv 10 opens at character Lv 32). Other Lv 12 and 16 picks need skill levels past 10 that the plan's points and nodes don't reach before Lv 45, so the guide leaves them out.
